title: Chulalongkorn Corpus of Spoken Thai (CCOST)
recordings_or_utterances: ~7h spontaneous + ~5h controlled; 206-item word list x2 and 25 sentences x3 per speaker
manual_annotation_units: orthographic; word; syllable; phone; toneme labels
manual_annotation_method: ASR/MAUS initial segmentation followed by manual correction by phonetically trained native Thai speakers
notes: Strong inclusion evidence in LREC 2026 paper; hand-corrected TextGrids are core target. Large 6.2GB archive should be handled via manifest/annotation extraction rather than committing audio.
